name: paper-tales
vibe: A pop-up storybook. Every film reads like a picture-book spread on warm paper: soft rose, butter and sky pastels, rounded Quicksand headings with handwritten Caveat asides, chapter tabs, paper-cutout characters and watercolor blooms. Motion is a children's book come alive — pages turn, pop-ups fold up from the crease, a pen writes the captions, confetti drifts down like torn paper. Sweet, gentle and sincere. For stories, founders' letters, gifts, education and anything told from the heart.

sfx.style: soft page turns, paper rustles, tiny chimes and gentle pops
